title: ID0390142-DC/Si-D/DK-[fuUDRK]- PowerConverter missing
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
PowerConverter missing
issue after not in use for 2 years
Root cause: Fastshutdown cables were inserted in CAN connector
Solution: Revert the CAN cables to the CAN connector
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Expired
The charger have been on the customers stock since delivery.
The charger has now been commissioned and shows power converter error.
Could this error be because that the converters have not been powered up for all most 2 years, so a power converter refresh is needed?
Is this a service we can buy from HQ?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390142-DC/Si-D/DK-[fuUDRK]- PowerConverter missing CRM:00645000863
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
Thank you for confirming the serial number.
As mentioned in my previous email, if the power converter remains unused for a long time, it may become faulty.
In this scenario, I recommend checking for any loose connections to the converter. If everything appears fine, replacing the converter would be advised.
If you require remote support while on-site, you can order expert service since the charger is out of warranty. For more information, please reach out to
Sousa, Afonso (afonso-sousa@siemens.com)
or
Teodoso, Rui (rui.teodoso@siemens.com)
.
Here is the MLFB of the power converter in case a replacement is needed:
Power Converter AC/DC 20kW > 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2.
Please let us know if you have any further queries otherwise we can move this ticket to your queue for further actions.
Thank you.
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0390142-DC/Si-D/DK-[fuUDRK]- PowerConverter missing CRM:00645000863
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus, good morning.
After yesterday's site visit we were able to bring the converters online. I investigated a little bit and it's impossible that this is a factory issue since the chargers leave the factory working without errors.
You need to check with the customer or any of your colleagues if they previously used this charger as spare part for another charger or related and when replacing the converter they mixed the cables.
From my side I already told you to align with Karsten Gebauer since the converter were only plugged in to see if they can reimburse you. In any case my personal opinion is that you should keep at least 1 for future replacement.
I will close the ticket since it's resolved.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
